transcript: Claude has now become insanely good at editing video and creating motion graphics, but it still struggles at adding good sound effects. That's because Claude can't hear. So every sound it adds is a guess, and as a result, the videos end up usually sounding pretty crappy. To fix this, use Earshot. It's a free and open-source AI tool that gives Claude Code ears, so it can actually listen to the sound effects that it adds. You just install it, it'll study your whole timeline and find the exact moments that it needs a sound effect, then it'll add one from its own library of over 250 professional sound effects. And if nothing fits, it'll even build a new one in code, generating a whole custom sound kit for your project for you. So if you want to try this, just comment Sound down below and I'll DM you the link directly.
